resources.string: Exact alarms are blocked. Tap to allow them, or the beep can be late.

HourBeep is a small hourly chime, in the manner of a Casio watch.

Developer: ali HOSSEINZADEH

What it does
• Plays one short sound at the top of each hour
• Optional quiet hours (both ends stay silent)
• Soft, Beep Beep, Cuckoo, or a real Casio recording
• Loudness slider for this app only

Privacy
• No network permission
• No ads, no analytics, no accounts
• Nothing is sent off the phone
• Source is GPL-3.0-only on GitHub

One short sound at the top of each hour, on the alarm volume. The slider turns that down for this app only. Music ducks for a moment. Nothing is sent off the phone. Quiet hours include both the start and the end. If a beep is missed after the screen has been off all day, tap Unrestrict battery.
